conditions.condition_text: Identify the 30-minute Orb by marking the high and low of the first 30-minute candle (9:30 AM - 10:00 AM NY time).
The 30-minute Orb defines the initial range for the strategy.
Wait for price to break the 30-minute Orb range (either above the high or below the low) to establish initial manipulation.
The strategy avoids simple breakouts or breakdowns due to poor risk-to-reward definition.
Wait for price to pull back and retest the 30-minute Orb high (for long) or low (for short).
The retest of the Orb acts as the high-probability entry trigger.
Enter short on the 5-minute candle close after price rejects the Orb low, with a stop loss placed right above the high of that rejection candle.
The rejection of the Orb low confirms bearish reversal intent.
Enter long on the 5-minute candle close after price retests the Orb high, with a stop loss placed right below the high of the 30-minute Orb candle.
The retest of the Orb high confirms bullish reversal intent.
The trade setup is strengthened by the presence of the pre-market high.
The setup is confirmed by an imbalance within the market.
The trade is validated by the alignment with order flow.
The stop is placed structurally below the swing low of the entry candle.
The primary target is the new high of the day.
The secondary target is based on achieving a 1:1 risk-to-reward ratio.
